result:
Four merged PRs since 2026-04-11 added or removed a line containing `configUrls` under `packages/tooling/openmrs`, best evidence first:

1. **PR #1905**, "Rewrite the openmrs CLI README around how it's used", merged 2026-10-02 (commit `b439966`). The README was rewritten and the new text adds `configUrls` lines: the build config example (`packages/tooling/openmrs/README.md:185`), the `--config-url` / `configUrls` row (`:199`), and the `${openmrsSpaBase}` note (`:213`).
2. **PR #1838**, "O3-5872: Add support for static compression of frontend", merged 2026-08-07 (commit `16a6c01`). The `assemble` epilog in `packages/tooling/openmrs/src/cli.ts` around line 395 was reworded. The old line listing the build keys, including `configUrls`, was removed, and a new line with `configUrls` was added in its place.
3. **PR #1894**, "(BREAKING) Remove offline & rxjs support from framework", merged 2026-09-28 (commit `a62f816`). The same epilog line in `packages/tooling/openmrs/src/cli.ts` was rewritten to drop `supportOffline`, so the line containing `configUrls` was removed and re-added.
4. **PR #1743**, "(BREAKING) Drop IMO and don't load arbitrary content in production mode", merged 2026-04-15 (commit `1dcccfd`). In `packages/tooling/openmrs/src/utils/config.test.ts`, the `configUrls` test was changed from `loadBundlerConfig({ configUrls: … })` to `setBundlerEnv({ configUrls: … })`, which removes and adds lines containing `configUrls`.

Dates are the commit dates of the squash-merged commits on `main`. I did not check the diffs of every commit in the window. I ruled out #1750, #1795, #1815, #1869, #1892 (for `cli.ts`), #1935 and #1916 by reading their diffs, or by checking that they don't touch the relevant files or lines. I did not check #1868, #1827, #1860, #1903, #1915, #1794, #3b9970b, #f91a68e, #fce9c4b, #7a172083 or #5473276. None of them is likely to touch `configUrls`, but I have not verified that. I made no changes to any files.
